termsSections.title: 1. Purpose
termsSections.body:
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Zoodomo service, available at zoodomo.com and its related pages. Zoodomo is an online service that lets animal shelters and professional sellers create and manage listings for their available animals (for adoption or sale), and get public pages ready to share or embed on their own website.

By creating an account or using the service, you accept these Terms without reservation. If you do not accept these Terms, you must not use the service.

termsSections.title: 2. Account and access to the service
termsSections.body:
Using the Zoodomo member area requires creating an account, reserved for animal shelters and professional animal sellers. You must provide accurate information when signing up and keep it up to date. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.

Zoodomo reserves the right to refuse, suspend, or close an account in case of non-compliance with these Terms, in particular in case of clearly inaccurate, misleading, or unlawful content.

termsSections.title: 3. Free trial and subscription
termsSections.body:
Creating an account grants access to a 15-day free trial, with no commitment. After this trial, continued use of the service requires a paid subscription, monthly or annual, priced as shown on the site at the time of subscription. The subscription renews automatically at each due date unless you cancel it from your member area.

Payment is processed by a third-party payment provider acting as a merchant of record. Zoodomo never has access to your full banking details.

termsSections.title: 4. Content published by the account
termsSections.body:
You remain solely responsible for the content you publish on Zoodomo (photos, descriptions, information about the animals, contact details). You guarantee that you hold the necessary rights to the photos you publish, and you commit to only publishing accurate information about the animals presented.

Zoodomo acts as the technical host of content published by accounts and does not exercise prior editorial control over this content. Zoodomo nonetheless reserves the right to remove any content that is clearly unlawful or in breach of these Terms once brought to its attention.

termsSections.title: 5. Prohibited use
termsSections.body: It is prohibited to use Zoodomo to publish unlawful or misleading content, content infringing on a third party's rights, or content unrelated to presenting animals for adoption or sale. It is also prohibited to attempt to bypass the service's security measures or to disrupt its operation.

termsSections.title: 6. Service availability
termsSections.body: Zoodomo makes reasonable efforts to ensure the availability of the service, without guaranteeing uninterrupted availability. Temporary interruptions may occur for maintenance, updates, or for reasons beyond Zoodomo's control (failure of a third-party technical provider, force majeure).

termsSections.title: 7. Termination and account deletion
termsSections.body:
You may cancel your subscription at any time from your member area. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid for (the current month or year): you keep access until that date, with no further renewal, and no refund is issued for the current period, which remains fully due.

You may also delete your account at any time from your member area. Deleting your account results in the permanent deletion of the associated data (animal listings, photos, messages), subject to any applicable legal retention obligations.

termsSections.title: 8. Liability
termsSections.body: Zoodomo cannot be held liable for damages resulting from improper use of the service, from content published by an account, or from temporary unavailability of the service. Zoodomo does not intervene in the relationship between an account and visitors to its public pages (adoption, sale, contact).

termsSections.title: 9. Changes to the Terms
termsSections.body: Zoodomo may change these Terms at any time. Accounts will be notified of any substantial change. Continued use of the service after a change constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

termsSections.title: 10. Governing law and disputes
termsSections.body: These Terms are governed by Belgian law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or performance falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Belgium.

termsSections.title: 11. Contact
termsSections.body: For any question about these Terms, you can contact Zoodomo at info@zoodomo.com.

privacySections.title: 1. Data controller
privacySections.body: Zoodomo is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. For any question or request regarding your data, you can contact us at info@zoodomo.com.

privacySections.title: 2. Data collected
privacySections.body:
Depending on your use of the service, Zoodomo collects:

- Your account information: name, email address, password (never stored in plain text), preferred language, and optionally phone number, postal address, and business registration number if you choose to provide them.
- The content you publish: animal listings, photos, descriptions, contact details you choose to make public.
- Limited technical data: language and display preference (see Cookies below), view counts on your animal listings, without identifying visitors.

Zoodomo does not collect any advertising tracking or visitor behavioral analytics data.

privacySections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
privacySections.body: Your data is processed to enable the service to work (creating and managing your account and animal listings), to manage your subscription, and to contact you about your account. This processing is necessary for the performance of the contract between you and Zoodomo (Terms of Service), or is based on Zoodomo's legitimate interest in ensuring the proper functioning of the service.

privacySections.title: 4. Data recipients
privacySections.body:
Your data is hosted and processed by the following processors, strictly within the scope of providing the service:

- Supabase (database, authentication, photo storage), hosted within the European Union (Paris region).
- Resend (sending transactional emails: account confirmation, notifications).
- LWS (hosting of the zoodomo.com domain name).
- Vercel (application hosting and aggregated page-view analytics, with no cookies or individual profile), based in the United States.
- Cloudflare (anti-bot protection on the signup and login forms).
- Sentry (detecting and diagnosing technical errors in the service, to fix bugs faster), hosted within the European Union (Germany). Sentry does not record video of sessions.
- Paddle (payment processing and subscription billing, acting as our official reseller), based in the United Kingdom.

Some of these providers may be located, or process data, outside the European Union; in that case, such transfers are covered by appropriate safeguards (European Commission standard contractual clauses).

Your data is never sold or passed on to third parties for advertising purposes.

privacySections.title: 5. Retention period
privacySections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, your data is permanently deleted, subject to any retention periods required by law (in particular for accounting and tax purposes, once online payment is live).

privacySections.title: 6. Your rights
privacySections.body: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at info@zoodomo.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).

privacySections.title: 7. Security
privacySections.body: Zoodomo implements appropriate technical measures to protect your data: password encryption, strict data isolation between accounts (row level security), access restricted to only the data needed for each feature.

refundSections.title: 1. Free trial before any payment
refundSections.body: Zoodomo offers a 15-day free trial, with no credit card required during this period. No payment is charged until you have chosen and confirmed a paid subscription (monthly or annual).

refundSections.title: 2. No refunds after payment
refundSections.body: Once a subscription is taken out, payments are non-refundable, including on a pro-rated basis for a period already started. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your member area; cancellation takes effect at the end of the already-paid period (current month or year), with no further renewal or charge.

refundSections.title: 3. Billing error
refundSections.body: In the event of a confirmed billing error (duplicate charge, incorrect amount), contact us via 'Contact the webmaster' from your member area, or at info@zoodomo.com. We will correct the error as soon as possible.

refundSections.title: 4. Payments processed by Paddle
refundSections.body: Payments are processed by Paddle.com Market Limited, our official reseller (Merchant of Record). In the event of a dispute or chargeback, Paddle may apply its own procedures, in accordance with its terms and conditions.
